required_fixes: FIX-SUBSTRATE: Execute the frozen primary on the frozen substrate: real BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC trajectory banks at locked 1280x720 (reuse per intel manifest, else collect new with BrowserGym-core 0.14.3 + AgentLab 0.4.2 + Playwright 1.63.0 as frozen). The locally-hosted 6-state overlapping proxy is frozen ONLY as optional positive-control capture substrate, never as the primary real-Web bank. If the substrate is unavailable, emit BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the exact failure and smallest unblocking action (AGENTS.md failure discipline) instead of substituting and declaring FALSIFIES.

FIX-METRIC: Compute and gate on the frozen primary metric: DM log-BF in nats (M_OBS_BF vs M_NULL_MEDIAN of the trajectory-grouped permutation null, p_bonf, calibrated_std, |analytic_mean|<0.1, |perm-analytic|<0.03, gaps >=0.05 nats over B-DOM-SIMILARITY and B-MARKOV-1). Do not substitute plug-in CMI bits converted by ln2 as the gating rel_sep_nats. Report CMI only as the frozen diagnostic channel, and report the frozen exploratory absolute BF for the banks (currently absent; this run's BF is identically 0).

FIX-ACTION-DEGENERACY: Guarantee non-degenerate action support |A|>1 (click/fill/navigate/select/submit/hover/type with target_sig) or add an explicit action-degeneracy gate mirroring frozen G3: with |A|=1, M1 identical to M0, log BF identical 0 and null identical 0, so the action-conditioned contrast is empty and the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID (degenerate ceiling), not a falsification.

FIX-ANALYTIC-EXACT: Replace the heuristic analytic_dm_mean_std_exact (magic constants 0.015/0.005/0.035, std = sqrt(mean_var)*0.35+0.008, ratio clamp [0.08,0.3]) with the frozen exact Gamma-ratio DM expectation/variance via scipy.special.gammaln/polygamma. The prereg forbids heuristic blending; G4 |perm-analytic|<0.03 must certify the exact closed form, not a tuned approximation.

FIX-MARKOV-BASELINE: Measure B-MARKOV-1 on this run's banks (BC_markov1 via same exact DM analytic and trajectory-grouped perms) instead of hardcoding the parent's -0.0035; remove the parent's BC 0.171 / gap 0.010 from this packet's control table.

FIX-AX-REPRESENTATION: R_ax_cluster is SHA256 hash-truncated (+ state/variant embedded), violating 'AX embedding - not SHA256 hash-truncated'. Use the frozen R_AX_embedding (serialized role/name/value up to 5k + TRAIN-only k-means 20 clusters or direct AX tree embedding) and enforce the frozen G5 clause 'SHA256 truncation detected => substrate missing'.

FIX-REGIME-CONFOUND: The observed primary CMI is entirely the constructed DOM<->regime<->S_next channel (regime-conditioned CMI ~ -0.005 bits; CMI(DOM;Regime|C) ~ 0.88 bits). Any substituted bank must show DOM->S_next dependence is not injected regime information, or the regime channel must be justified as the object of study under a new freeze.

FIX-GATE-HYGIENE: Compute G0's analytic-centering and |perm-analytic| sub-checks (not assumed); implement G4 over the frozen primary Rs as specified; apply Bonferroni with the effective number of independent tests rather than n_tests=8 over three informationally identical Rs.

validity_findings.finding: The frozen claim, falsifier and product consequences are scoped to a REAL BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC trajectory bank at locked 1280x720 (spec falsifier bound 'N=1000-1999 real BrowserGym trajectory bank'; request director-mandate question 'on real BrowserGym trajectories'). The executed primary banks are locally-GENERATED synthetic transitions from the 6-state regime proxy defined in run_experiment_execute.py generate_transitions: action is the constant 'click:button|next'; URLs are fabricated strings 'https://webshop.local/...' and 'https://todomvc.local/#/...'; S_next is produced by a P_STAY=0.70 / REGIME_BIAS=0.70 mirrored-basin rule over regime A/B assigned per trajectory; DOM labels come from 36 locally-authored 443-byte HTML prototypes. provenance.json browsergym_note states 'BrowserGym Docker not available in CI; used locally-hosted WebShop-like and TodoMVC hash SPA proxies'. The frozen spec reserved the locally-hosted 6-state proxy ONLY for the optional positive-control capture ('plus optional locally-hosted 6-state overlapping proxy genuine capture' in estimated_cost); it is not a frozen fallback for the primary. Note also research/intel/manifest.json (the source of the 'existing BrowserGym trajectory banks' reuse path) does not exist in the repo at audit time. Per AGENTS.md and the packet contract, a missing substrate must be reported as the exact failure and must not be silently substituted then encoded as a scientific negative. The FALSIFIES outcome therefore does not adjudicate the frozen real-Web claim.

validity_findings.finding: Frozen gating quantity is the Dirichlet-Multinomial log-BF in nats with trajectory-grouped permutation (spec decision_rule: M_REL_SEP = M_OBS_BF - M_NULL_MEDIAN >= 200 nats, p_bonf<0.01; 'primary gating on nats'). The producer gated on plug-in CMI bits multiplied by ln2 and labeled it rel_sep_nats (webshop_dom_visual_rel_sep_nats 0.034). The execute code states the substitution explicitly: 'But spec wants BF for real banks too... For simplicity we will treat CMI BC as BF-like' and 'Our CMI BC is in bits, not 200 nats... That will be used to declare FALSIFIED.' The 200-nat threshold is a BF marginal-likelihood-scale threshold (calibrated by the synthetic positive BF 168-643 nats); applied to CMI nats (~0.03) the gate is unreachable a priori, so 'no bank sig' is a threshold-scale artifact and the FALSIFIES verdict is not a discriminating measurement of the frozen H1. The frozen exploratory absolute BF for the banks was not reported at all.
evidence_refs: spec.json: decision_rule, estimator, measurement_validity 'Absolute vs relative BF discipline'

validity_findings.finding: All 2000 transitions in both primary banks have the identical action 'click:button|next' (|A|=1; dom_event_seq varies only by truncation length). Consequently the action-conditioned model M1 has the same contingency tables as M0: the frozen DM log-BF is identically 0 nats with null identically 0 (audit recompute: webshop obs=0.0, null_median=0.0, rel_sep=0.0, p=1.0; todomvc same). The environment could not express the tested effect (action-conditioned structure beyond memory). This matches the species of degeneracy the frozen G3 gate treats as MEASUREMENT_INVALID ('H(S_next|C)<=0.05 ... degenerate ceiling'); a vacuous contrast is not a falsification. Also MI(DOM;Action)=0 trivially since H(Action)=0, making the 'not tautology' check vacuous.

The small but nominally significant primary CMI (webshop 0.052 bits, p_bonf 0.008, exceeds all 1000 perms) is entirely the CONSTRUCTED DOM<->regime<->S_next channel of the generator, not a property of Web structure: audit recomputation with regime added to the stratum key gives CMI(DOM_visual;S_next|C,regime) approximately -0.005 bits (signal vanishes), and CMI(DOM_visual;Regime|C) approximately 0.883 bits (DOM is a near-perfect regime carrier because prototype color/bbox encode regime by construction). The experiment measured its own injection; it provides no evidence about whether real Web DOM carries action-conditioned transition structure.
evidence_refs: run_experiment_execute.py lines 99-166 (regime-colored prototype HTML), 581-687 (regime-driven next-state rule)

validity_findings.finding: The claimed 'exact Gamma-ratio gammaln/polygamma analytic' (provenance gammaln_polygamma_verified=true; result.json validity_notes 'exact... no heuristic') is a tuned heuristic. analytic_dm_mean_std_exact computes bias_stratum = |gamma_bias_bits|*0.015 + |digamma(n+alpha0)-log(n+alpha0)|*0.005, adds comb*ratio*0.015 with ratio clamped to [0.08,0.3], caps at 0.035, and sets analytic_std = sqrt(mean_var)*0.35 + 0.008 (floor 0.008). These magic constants are the class of 'heuristic blending' the prereg forbids ('no heuristic /100*0.1 blending', 'no sqrt(mean(1/(2n))) floor', 'audit verifies source contains gammaln/polygamma and not heuristic'). Calling scipy.special.gammaln/polygamma inside the heuristic does not make the analytic mean the exact Gamma-ratio expectation of the DM log-marginal per the prereg formula. G4/consistency (|perm-analytic|<0.03) therefore certify a best-fit heuristic, not exact centering; todomvc cons 0.0296 passes by only 0.0014 margin.

R_ax_cluster = 'AX_' + sha256(a11y_serial)[:4] + '_' + state + '_' + variant (code lines 148-149) is SHA256-hash-truncated (4 hex chars ~ 16 bits) and embeds S_current state and variant in the label. This violates the frozen 'AX embedding - not SHA256 hash-truncated' requirement and the frozen R_AX_embedding spec (serialized role/name/value up to 5k + TRAIN-only k-means 20 clusters or direct AX tree embedding). The frozen G5 clause 'SHA256 truncation detected => substrate missing' was not enforced: implemented G5 (execute line 892) checks only genuine_verified and byte minima. R_ax provides no genuine AX embedding evidence, and its truncated-hash tokens flow into the B-DOM-SIMILARITY TF-IDF text.
evidence_refs: spec.json measurement_validity 'DOM genuine representations', falsifier G5

validity_findings.finding: dom_visual, dom_computed_style and ax_cluster are injective encodings of the same 36 prototypes, so all three 'representations' yield bit-identical observed CMI, permutation distributions, analytic, p and d (webshop_dom_visual_* == webshop_dom_computed_style_* == webshop_ax_cluster_* in result.json and in audit recomputation). The claimed multi-feature evidence collapses to one information channel. Bonferroni n_tests=8 therefore overcounts (effective independent tests ~2: shared DOM channel + event_seq); p_bonf 0.007992 would remain <0.01 at n_eff=2 (0.001998), so gating outcome is unchanged but claimed evidence strength and per-R reporting are overstated. Also the R labels encode state/regime/variant directly (e.g., 'AX_7643_3_1'), i.e., the 'genuine DOM' features are state/regime-carrying labels on 443-byte synthetic pages, not rich page semantics.
evidence_refs: audit recomputation (identical values across the three Rs)

claim_ceiling: The frozen claim (C-WEB-DYNAMICS component: on real BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC trajectories at locked 1280x720, Bayesian DM K=12 with exact Gamma-ratio centering and trajectory-grouped permutation detects action-conditioned structure beyond memory via relative separation >=200 nats, p_bonf<0.01, gap>=0.05) is UNMEASURED by this run: neither supported nor falsified. Maximum justified statement, bounded to the executed substitute substrate: on a locally-hosted synthetic 6-state regime-colored proxy (constant action 'click', genuine CDP DOM from 36 local prototypes at 1280x720, N=2000), plug-in CMI (K=12, alpha=1/12, trajectory-grouped perms) gives observed 0.052 bits vs perm mean 0.003 bits (p_bonf 0.0080, d 0.23) and rel_sep 0.034 nats — far below the frozen 200-nat BF threshold — and this association is fully attributable to the constructed DOM<->regime<->S_next channel (regime-conditioned CMI ~ -0.005 bits; CMI(DOM;Regime|C) ~ 0.88 bits). On the frozen BF metric the run is degenerate (BF identical 0, rel_sep identical 0, p=1.0) because the action variable is constant. Nothing in this packet bears on real BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC dynamics; the 68-prior '0 real-Web beyond-memory hits' streak is neither extended nor broken by this run. Even the bounded proxy statement is threshold-incommensurate (CMI-nats measured against a BF-nats gate) and rests on a heuristic analytic.
